title: Effects of Impending Winding up of Dream Cruises and Genting Hong Kong Ltd and Measures to Mitigate Negative Impact on Singapore as Cruise Hub
what_it_is: Effects of Impending Winding up of Dream Cruises and Genting Hong Kong Ltd and Measures to Mitigate Negative Impact on Singapore as Cruise Hub

sections.label: Dream Cruises winding up impact
sections.summary: Ministry monitors Dream Cruises' winding up effects on Marina Bay Cruise Centre and Singapore's cruise hub, citing suspended bookings and Royal Caribbean's earlier deployment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (a) what is the Ministry’s assessment on the possible effects of the impending winding up of Dream Cruises and Genting Hong Kong Ltd on (i) the business of the Marina Bay Cruise Centre Singapore (MBCCS) and (ii) Singapore as a cruise hub; and (b) what measures will be taken to mitigate any negative impact on Singapore as a cruise hub.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We are closely monitoring the impact of these developments on those who have booked upcoming sailings on Dream Cruises' ship, World Dream, as well as the impact on Marina Bay Cruise Centre Singapore (MBCCS) and also on Singapore's cruise industry.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: While new bookings with Dream Cruises have been suspended from 21 January 2022, World Dream currently continues to sail from Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Royal Caribbean has recently brought forward its deployment of Spectrum of the Seas from October 2022 to April 2022, which will provide business opportunities for MBCCS.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Singapore Tourism Board is also in discussions with other cruise lines on their interest to resume sailings from Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: As Singapore transits towards living with endemic COVID-19, we will continue our efforts to anchor more cruise ships in Singapore and maintain Singapore's attractiveness as a cruise hub in the region.
